cohort: Women with placenta previa delivered at a single hospital over a period of 9 years
finding: Morbidly adherent placenta previa (MAPP) was associated with previous LSCS, maternal age ≥35 years, anterior or central placenta, and history of placenta previa, and was a significant risk factor for severe maternal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: This study found an association between previous lower segment cesarean sections (LSCS) and an increased risk of morbidly adherent placenta previa (MAPP).
